long_biography.plain_text:
Arrowhead began in 1981 as a mobile service provider for the oilfield, where equipment preparation had to be delivered in demanding operating conditions. Helling became the company's owner-operator and guided its expansion into the refurbishment of heavy construction machinery, linking technical surface preparation with the practical needs of equipment sellers and fleet owners.

Under his leadership, the business developed a nationwide network serving major auction facilities. Its work combined power washing, abrasive blasting, industrial painting, detailing and finishing, turning used machinery into sale-ready assets. Arrowhead's long association with Ritchie Brothers Auctioneers gave the company recurring access to large equipment marketplaces. The present organization retains that operating model while placing day-to-day leadership with a new executive team.
